summary: VPS staging cannot produce any answer: the only LLM credential is expired. opencode.ai returns 401 api_key_expired; the same key and the expert key both fail at api.deepseek.com with 401 authentication_error.
root_cause: Rotated/expired OPENAI_API_KEY in /opt/chatbot/bridge/.env (provider opencode.ai/zen/go/v1) with no replacement; DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in /opt/chatbot/docker/.env and expert/.env are not valid DeepSeek credentials either. Secondary: the opencode endpoint additionally rejects requests without an x-opencode-session header (400 MissingSessionID), so a fresh key alone will not be enough.
recovery: Not resolved; requires a new API key from the owner. Prompt change (disable name/NIK/email solicitation) is applied and loaded, but behavioural verification is impossible until a valid key exists.
prevention: Alert on 401/api_key_expired from the LLM provider; store the live key in one secret store and document expiry/rotation; add the required x-opencode-session header to the client so key rotation alone restores service.
